author: Inside Edition
description: Thomas Markle Sr., father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, has been arrested in Florida. The US Attorney's Office says he is charged with one count of possession of child pornography. Officials say he was taken into custody Friday morning in Tampa by federal officials. According to the criminal complaint, Markle Sr. kept sexually explicit photographs of himself with prepubescent girls in storage facilities he rented in Los Angeles. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Thomas Markle Sr. Arrested For Having Child Sexual Abuse Material: DOJ

author: Inside Edition
description: A woman narrowly escaped her vehicle after it started smoking. Authorities in Slidell, Louisiana, say the woman pulled into a gas station to fuel up, but her car shut down on her. Moments later smoke started billowing from under the hood. Gas station attendants rushed to help her get away. A state trooper who witnessed the incident used a fire extinguisher to help before firefighters could arrive. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Woman Narrowly Escapes Car After It Starts Smoking At Gas Station

author: Inside Edition
description: Your odds of getting struck by lightning are low, but not zero. A Miami couple says they were in the right places when lightning struck their home. Hailey Schafer was waiting on her porch for her boyfriend Armando Latour. He was sitting in his vehicle when it struck. While they weren't directly hit, they say they felt the force of nature. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Couple Felt Electricity From Lightning Bolt Close Call

author: Inside Edition
description: Coral reefs are another victim of climate change as warming oceans are causing reefs to lose their color and essentially die.Scientists at Stanford University say they've found a way to help  the bleached coral return to normal, by simply introducing it to already healthy coral. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Scientists Find Success In Reviving Bleached Coral Reefs
